assignment_bootstrap_provenance_ck.name: assignment_bootstrap_provenance_ck
assignment_bootstrap_provenance_ck.value: ("control"."assignment"."bootstrap_mandate_id" is null)=("control"."assignment"."bootstrap_platform_participant_id" is null) and ("control"."assignment"."bootstrap_mandate_id" is null or (cardinality("control"."assignment"."runtime_capability_ids")=0 and "control"."assignment"."onward_delegation_depth"=0))

authority_envelope_platform_binding_ck.name: authority_envelope_platform_binding_ck
authority_envelope_platform_binding_ck.value:
("control"."authority_envelope"."platform_context_id" is null and "control"."authority_envelope"."platform_authority_epoch" is null)
          or ("control"."authority_envelope"."platform_context_id" is not null and "control"."authority_envelope"."platform_authority_epoch" is not null
            and "control"."authority_envelope"."platform_authority_epoch" between 0 and 18446744073709551615)

authority_envelope_bootstrap_provenance_.name: authority_envelope_bootstrap_provenance_ck
authority_envelope_bootstrap_provenance_.value: ("control"."authority_envelope"."bootstrap_mandate_id" is null)=("control"."authority_envelope"."bootstrap_platform_participant_id" is null) and ("control"."authority_envelope"."bootstrap_mandate_id" is null or (cardinality("control"."authority_envelope"."runtime_capability_ids")=0 and "control"."authority_envelope"."onward_delegation_depth"=0))

authority_role_bootstrap_provenance_ck.name: authority_role_bootstrap_provenance_ck
authority_role_bootstrap_provenance_ck.value: ("control"."authority_role"."bootstrap_mandate_id" is null)=("control"."authority_role"."bootstrap_platform_participant_id" is null) and ("control"."authority_role"."bootstrap_mandate_id" is null or "control"."authority_role"."origin"='BOOTSTRAP')

pending_delivery_digest_lengths_ck.name: pending_delivery_digest_lengths_ck
pending_delivery_digest_lengths_ck.value: octet_length("correlated_log_identity_hmac") = 32 and octet_length("entity_hmac") = 32 and octet_length("entity_scope_digest") = 32 and octet_length("protected_delivery_reference_digest") = 32 and ("subscription_reference_digest" is null or octet_length("subscription_reference_digest") = 32) and ("session_reference_digest" is null or octet_length("session_reference_digest") = 32)

pending_delivery_surface_references_ck.name: pending_delivery_surface_references_ck
pending_delivery_surface_references_ck.value: ("delivery_surface" = 'WEBSOCKET' and "subscription_reference_digest" is not null and "session_reference_digest" is not null) or ("delivery_surface" = 'INDEXER' and "subscription_reference_digest" is null and "session_reference_digest" is not null) or ("delivery_surface" in ('HTTP','LOG','RECEIPT') and "subscription_reference_digest" is null and "session_reference_digest" is null)

pending_delivery_lifecycle_facts_ck.name: pending_delivery_lifecycle_facts_ck
pending_delivery_lifecycle_facts_ck.value: "last_observed_at" >= "first_observed_at" and (("state" = 'LEASED') = ("lease_owner" is not null and "lease_expires_at" is not null)) and (("state" = 'RETRY_WAIT') = ("next_retry_at" is not null))

credential_public_key_ck.name: credential_public_key_ck
credential_public_key_ck.value: "control"."credential"."kind" not in ('WEBAUTHN', 'WORKLOAD_MTLS') or "control"."credential"."public_key_digest" is not null

credential_oidc_ck.name: credential_oidc_ck
credential_oidc_ck.value: "control"."credential"."kind" not in ('OIDC_SUBJECT', 'WORKLOAD_OIDC') or ("control"."credential"."issuer" is not null and "control"."credential"."subject" is not null)

credential_workload_mtls_ck.name: credential_workload_mtls_ck
credential_workload_mtls_ck.value: "control"."credential"."kind" <> 'WORKLOAD_MTLS' or ("control"."credential"."issuer" is not null and "control"."credential"."subject" is not null and "control"."credential"."audience" is not null and "control"."credential"."public_key_digest" is not null and octet_length("control"."credential"."public_key_digest") = 32 and "control"."credential"."public_key_spki_der" is not null and "control"."credential"."secret_fingerprint" is not null and octet_length("control"."credential"."secret_fingerprint") = 32 and "control"."credential"."valid_until" is not null)

credential_certificate_der_ck.name: credential_certificate_der_ck
credential_certificate_der_ck.value: "control"."credential"."certificate_der" is null or ("control"."credential"."kind" = 'WORKLOAD_MTLS' and octet_length("control"."credential"."certificate_der") between 1 and 24576 and sha256("control"."credential"."certificate_der") = "control"."credential"."secret_fingerprint")

oidc_transaction_purpose_ck.name: oidc_transaction_purpose_ck
oidc_transaction_purpose_ck.value: "control"."oidc_transaction"."purpose" in ('SESSION','INVITATION') and ("control"."oidc_transaction"."purpose"='SESSION' or "control"."oidc_transaction"."selected_participant_id" is not null)

recovery_replacement_ck.name: recovery_replacement_ck
recovery_replacement_ck.value:
num_nonnulls("control"."recovery_challenge"."replacement_credential_id","control"."recovery_challenge"."replacement_enrolled_at")=0
        or (num_nonnulls("control"."recovery_challenge"."replacement_credential_id","control"."recovery_challenge"."replacement_enrolled_at")=2 and "control"."recovery_challenge"."replacement_required"=true
          and "control"."recovery_challenge"."outcome"='COMPLETED' and "control"."recovery_challenge"."consumed_at" is not null and "control"."recovery_challenge"."replacement_enrolled_at">="control"."recovery_challenge"."consumed_at")

recovery_post_review_ck.name: recovery_post_review_ck
recovery_post_review_ck.value:
num_nonnulls("control"."recovery_challenge"."reviewed_by_principal_id","control"."recovery_challenge"."reviewed_at","control"."recovery_challenge"."review_note") = 0
        or (num_nonnulls("control"."recovery_challenge"."reviewed_by_principal_id","control"."recovery_challenge"."reviewed_at","control"."recovery_challenge"."review_note") = 3
          and "control"."recovery_challenge"."outcome"='COMPLETED' and "control"."recovery_challenge"."consumed_at" is not null
          and "control"."recovery_challenge"."reviewed_at" >= "control"."recovery_challenge"."consumed_at"
          and length(btrim("control"."recovery_challenge"."review_note")) between 10 and 1024
          and "control"."recovery_challenge"."reviewed_by_principal_id" not in ("control"."recovery_challenge"."principal_id","control"."recovery_challenge"."recovery_principal_id"))

recovery_distinct_custodians_ck.name: recovery_distinct_custodians_ck
recovery_distinct_custodians_ck.value: "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_one_principal_id" is null or "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_two_principal_id" is null or "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_one_principal_id" <> "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_two_principal_id"

recovery_authority_binding_ck.name: recovery_authority_binding_ck
recovery_authority_binding_ck.value:
num_nonnulls("control"."recovery_challenge"."recovery_principal_epoch","control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_one_epoch","control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_two_epoch") = 0
          or (num_nonnulls("control"."recovery_challenge"."recovery_principal_epoch","control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_one_epoch","control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_two_epoch") = 3
            and "control"."recovery_challenge"."privacy_domain_id" is not null
            and "control"."recovery_challenge"."recovery_principal_epoch" >= 0 and "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_one_epoch" >= 0 and "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_two_epoch" >= 0
            and "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_one_principal_id" is not null and "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_two_principal_id" is not null
            and "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_one_principal_id" not in ("control"."recovery_challenge"."principal_id","control"."recovery_challenge"."recovery_principal_id")
            and "control"."recovery_challenge"."custodian_two_principal_id" not in ("control"."recovery_challenge"."principal_id","control"."recovery_challenge"."recovery_principal_id"))

session_context_ck.name: session_context_ck
session_context_ck.value: ("control"."session"."context_mode" = 'PLATFORM' and "control"."session"."privacy_domain_id" is null) or ("control"."session"."context_mode" = 'PARTICIPANT' and "control"."session"."privacy_domain_id" is not null)

webauthn_enrollment_consumed_ck.name: webauthn_enrollment_consumed_ck
webauthn_enrollment_consumed_ck.value: ("control"."webauthn_enrollment"."consumed_at" is null) = ("control"."webauthn_enrollment"."credential_id" is null and "control"."webauthn_enrollment"."attestation_digest" is null)

platform_context_scoped_read.name: platform_context_scoped_read
platform_context_scoped_read.using:
exists(select 1 from control.authority_envelope envelope
          where envelope.platform_context_id="control"."platform_context"."platform_context_id"
            and openpc.matches_participant(envelope.participant_id))

subject_membership_visibility.name: subject_membership_visibility
subject_membership_visibility.using:
exists (select 1 from control.participant_membership membership
      where membership.identity_subject_id="control"."identity_subject"."identity_subject_id"
        and openpc.matches_participant(membership.participant_id))

subject_initial_creation.name: subject_initial_creation
subject_initial_creation.withCheck:
exists (select 1 from control.principal principal
      where principal.principal_id="control"."identity_subject"."identity_subject_id"
        and principal.kind in ('USER','PLATFORM_OPERATOR')
        and openpc.matches_participant(principal.participant_id))

identity_oidc_binding_state_ck.name: identity_oidc_binding_state_ck
identity_oidc_binding_state_ck.value: ("control"."identity_oidc_binding"."state" in ('UNVERIFIED_LEGACY','BOUND') and "control"."identity_oidc_binding"."identity_subject_id" is not null) or ("control"."identity_oidc_binding"."state"='AMBIGUOUS_LEGACY' and "control"."identity_oidc_binding"."identity_subject_id" is null)

invitation_token_authority_ck.name: invitation_token_authority_ck
invitation_token_authority_ck.value:
"control"."participant_invitation_token"."issuance_authority" is null or coalesce((
        jsonb_typeof("control"."participant_invitation_token"."issuance_authority")='object'
        and "control"."participant_invitation_token"."issuance_authority"->>'version'='1'
        and "control"."participant_invitation_token"."issuance_authority"->>'operationId'="control"."participant_invitation_token"."operation_id"::text
        and jsonb_array_length("control"."participant_invitation_token"."issuance_authority"->'authorities')=4
        and jsonb_array_length("control"."participant_invitation_token"."issuance_authority"->'signers')=2
        and "control"."participant_invitation_token"."issuance_authority" ?& array['approvalRequestId','candidateDigest','authorities','signers','operationId','version']
      ),false)

bootstrap_acceptance_ck.name: bootstrap_acceptance_ck

business_signing_selection_change_ck.name: business_signing_selection_change_ck

audit_occurrence_states_ck.name: audit_occurrence_states_ck

       then "control"."signing_rotation_command"."original_operation_id" is not null and "control"."signing_rotation_command"."recovery_attempt_id" is not null and "control"."signing_rotation_command"."prior_observation_digest" is not null and octet_length("control"."signing_rotation_command"."prior_observation_digest")=32

signing_history_protected_effect_ck.name: signing_history_protected_effect_ck
signing_history_protected_effect_ck.value: "control"."signing_rotation_history"."state" not in ('OLD_REVOKED','COMPLETE') or ("control"."signing_rotation_history"."receipt_id" is not null and "control"."signing_rotation_history"."evidence_id" is not null and ("control"."signing_rotation_history"."prior_state"="control"."signing_rotation_history"."state" or "control"."signing_rotation_history"."event_id" is not null))

signing_history_receipt_ordinal_ck.name: signing_history_receipt_ordinal_ck

signing_continuation_digest_ck.name: signing_continuation_digest_ck
